CustomField.description: Status for signer lists, including who a signature was reassigned to or delegated from.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Reassigned"), "↪ Reassigned to " & Reassigned_To__r.Name, IF(ISBLANK(Delegated_From__c), TEXT(Status__c), TEXT(Status__c) & " · delegate of " & Delegated_From__r.Name))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Status for lists, including who a signature was reassigned to or delegated from.
CustomField.label: Signing Status
